title: MUSCLE MANGA - Jack Hanma's Physique in Grappler Baki
summary: Muscle Manga episode on Jack Hanma of Grappler Baki, the only openly steroid-using character in a cast NH jokingly calls certified natty. NH narrates Jack's pre-fight drug rituals, his biting style, his monstrous neck, traps and upper back, and the tragic origin story that drives his self-destructive obsession with beating his father Yujiro.
claims: Officially every Grappler Baki character is natural, despite absurd physiques like a 365 lb teenager at 10% body fat, except Jack Hanma
Jack Hanma is the only Baki character shown using steroids: testosterone, Deca, Anavar and Tren before fights
At 6'3 and 255 lb, Jack has the best mix of muscle mass, leanness and frame in the tournament
Jack's jaw and neck strength let him bite through coconuts, carry opponents in his mouth and resist a rear-naked choke
Jack's response to drugs is beyond any real steroid user: world records in sprinting, powerlifting and weightlifting within weeks
Jack's most developed muscles are the arms, legs and neck, with traps and upper back that swell during combat
Jack's progression came from drugs plus an indomitable spirit that refuses rest and has no care for tomorrow, which also destroys him
Jack's obsession with defeating Yujiro comes from being his son, born of his mother's rape and raised in poverty
